title: Pocketwire Rewards Frequent Redeemer Terms: Charity Donation Valuation
content:
The value of a Pocketwire Rewards charity donation depends on how many redemptions of any kind the member made within the last twelve months.

## Terms

The charity valuation depends on the redemptions of any kind dated within the last twelve months: with at least 5 of them the value is banded, the first 20000 points donated being valued at the charity rate and every point beyond them at the charity rate plus 0.10 cents; with at least 2 but fewer than 5 of them the value is every point donated at the charity rate plus a block bonus of 200 cents for every full 10000 points donated. With fewer than 2, no such adjustment applies.

The value is worked out in US cents. Redemptions of any kind are the cash, gift card and charity redemption entries on the member's Pocketwire Rewards points ledger. A date lies within the last twelve months when it is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Valuation by redemption count

| Redemptions within the last twelve months | Valuation |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | banded: first 20000 points at the charity rate, each point beyond at the charity rate plus 0.10 cents |
| 2 to 4 | block bonus: every point at the charity rate, plus 200 cents per full 10000 points |
| 0 or 1 | no such adjustment |

## Worked examples (hypothetical donation of 25600 points at a charity rate of 1.35 cents per point)

- Banded: 25600 multiplied by 1.35 is 34560 cents; the 5600 points beyond the first 20000 add 5600 multiplied by 0.10, which is 560 cents; 35120 cents in all, 351.20 USD.
- Block bonus: 34560 cents, and 25600 points hold 2 full blocks of 10000, adding 400 cents; 34960 cents in all, 349.60 USD.
- A donation of 9900 points under the block bonus holds no full block of 10000 and adds nothing.
